angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 208,153 km at 41.02 pc = 0.07 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 24.3773 +/- 0.0162 mas (same row, RUWE 1.31): 41.02 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.2992 +/- 0.0073 solar radii from Ghachoui et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-5713 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...690A.263G/abstract): 208,153 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.2653 +/- 0.0061 solar masses from Ghachoui et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-5713 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...690A.263G/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3225 +/- 41 K from Ghachoui et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-5713 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...690A.263G/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Ghachoui et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-5713 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...690A.263G/abstract)
